_meta.openai/widgetDescription: The shared OffStereo story player: a changing narration-and-song stage with the complete chapter list beneath it.

description: Create one playable OffStereo card for a direct standalone-song or narrated-story request. Discovery and Music Today already play their songs, so keep those results in their original card unless the listener asks for dedicated controls. experience=single_track returns exactly one recording with no narration or library save; pass artist plus track. experience=story progressively creates a sourced story; mode=fresh starts a new build. Pass artist plus album for an exact record and trackCount for an exact requested length. Spotify, Apple Music, and SoundCloud URLs are story seeds unless the listener requests only the recording. Playlist requests use create_playlist. existingSessionId opens a selected library story; get_session is reserved for card polling. The mounted card owns live progress and playback. Assistant prose should avoid restating transient stages such as building, recording, or still working because they become stale as the card updates, and should wait for Ready before stating final counts. A tool call opens the card without starting playback.

album.description: Exact album or EP title, paired with artist when the listener names or shows a specific record.

artist.description: Exact artist, paired with track for a one-song card or with album for an album-focused story.

existingSessionId.description: The chosen library story id for opening through the canonical player contract; get_session remains application polling.

experience.description: single_track means one immediate song card with no narration or story creation; story means the full progressive narrated experience.

length.description: short fits an explicitly quick, brief, or concise narrated story and targets three narration-and-record chapters; standard keeps the full editorial arc.

mode.description: fresh starts an explicitly new story; auto may reuse an exact strong match.

personalization.description: library uses connected-listener taste as retrieval seeds; none is the default.

prompt.description: What the listening experience should explain.

resumeShowId.description: Rebuild an unfinished show in place, keeping its id and URL, instead of creating a second one. Pass the id of a show whose `retryable` is true. Rejected for a show that already finished or that belongs to someone else.

sourceText.description: Source text or conversation context to adapt.

sourceUrl.description: An http(s) article or source URL to adapt.

title.description: Short canonical artist, track, album, or subject title for the card, especially useful for an identified image or a prompt that also contains workflow instructions.

track.description: Exact song title, paired with artist for reliable single_track matching.

trackCount.description: Exact number of songs requested for a narrated story (2-12). Use 1 with experience=single_track.

tracks.description: Optional: exact records the story should always include as playable tracks — e.g. every song a paired video names. They are pinned into the show in this order and curation fills the remaining slots up to trackCount, so a companion keeps the records the video discusses. Leave unset for normal curation.

videoMode.description: When true, the story opens on a third-person editorial hook with no DJ greeting or time-of-day welcome — for a companion story paired with a video. Pair with an explicit `title` so page title, URL, and register all match the video.

name: make_playable

outputSchema.description: A PlayableSession: one canonical OffStereo card with its ordered narration-and-song queue and live build/playback status.

id.description: Stable session id, reused for get_session and steer_session.

playbackDirective.description: One-shot transport request the mounted card applies.

status.description: Lifecycle: building, partial, ready, failed, and similar.

title: Play music or a story
